t: This is the grave of William Kingdon Clifford, the English mathematician and philosopher. Building on the work of Hermann Grassmann, he introduced what is now called geometric algebra, a special case of what became known as Clifford algebras, named in his honour. They have grown ever more important in mathematical physics, geometry and computing. Clifford was also the first to suggest that gravitation might be a manifestation of an underlying geometry. He lived from 1845 to 1879.
